scope: Official standard-device capacity and architectural throughput, not a measured speedup or fit guarantee. Current GPU reports48GiB; standard5090 has32GB. Future192width activations/workspace/driver compatibility need exclusive production probes. No card transfer or precision change performed.

theoretical_peak_comparison.method: Nominal reference boost, FP32=2*CUDAcores*boost_GHz/1000 TFLOP/s; non-Tensor FP64=FP32/64. These are derived theoretical peaks, not observed training speed.
theoretical_peak_comparison.clarification: Both CC8.6 and CC12.0 have FP32:FP64=64:1. No evidence this3090 has better FP64 than5090; theoretical5090 peak is approximately2.94x. Current reported48GiB is capacity, not additional arithmetic throughput. No5090training measured.

nonstandard_memory_assessment: NVML reports48GiB versus standard3090 24GB; expansion/platform customization is plausible, but software queries cannot establish physical modifications. Driver reports82SM/CC8.6/ratio64; no evidence of added FP64 throughput.
